body:
More on Ratfolk from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Ratfolk (9 RP)" but are not part of the Ratfolk entry, which is unchanged.

Random Ratfolk Height and Weight
Gender	Base Height	Height Modifier	Base Weight	Weight Modifier
Male	3 ft. 7 in.	+2d4 in.
(3 ft. 9 in. – 4 ft. 3 in.)	65 lbs.	+(2d4×3 lbs.)
(71 – 89 lbs.)
Female	3 ft. 4 in.	+2d4 in.
(3 ft. 4 in. – 4 ft.)	50 lbs.	+(2d4×3 lbs.)
(56 – 74 lbs.)

Oracle Add a +1 bonus on concentration checks when casting oracle spells and within 5 feet of an ally. (Source JBE:SF:FCO)
Paladin Add +5 minutes to the amount of time before a condition returns when using one of your mercies (to a maximum of 1 additional hour). (Source JBE:SF:FCO)
